dt: Annual call via NSPIRES (as an appendix to SpaceTech-REDDI). The last posted cycle had a Nov 1 deadline; the next call is not yet posted.
e: Graduate fellowships for space-technology research such as sensors, optics and materials. Each fellow gets a NASA collaborator and a visiting-technologist stay at a NASA center. U.S. citizens, nationals and permanent residents only; applicants must be undergraduates or first-year graduate students at the time of applying.
n: NASA Space Technology Graduate Research Opportunities (NSTGRO)
unv: Award figures and eligibility come from the Fall 2025 solicitation, whose proposals were due Nov 1, 2024. The date of the next cycle is unknown.
